name: Tendo Studio
exploreLabel: Public artwork archive and individual image pages
problem: Custom creative enquiries need reference images, dimensions, material direction, destination and deadline questions in one place. The commission planner turns scattered social inspiration into an organised brief, while retaining artist credits and avoiding claims about stock or prices.
websiteStatus: Urban Change Lab's first-person artisan profile identifies Tendo Studio and points to Instagram as its website. No standalone official Kenyan domain was verified. The public Instagram profile was inspected and describes a creative community and artist-residency interests; this is evidence of a social-first presence, not proof a website has never existed.
socialCaption: Public studio-feed images, including credited collaborating artists; per-image original post URLs retained in gallery metadata
heroAlt: Real business-published artwork images displayed in an original virtual Three.js gallery; no generated product photographs
